symptom: splr 0.17.2 aborts while solving certain satisfiable CNFs during variable elimination: 'assertion left != right failed, left: Some(false), right: Some(false)' at src/processor/eliminate.rs:210 (debug_assert_ne!(asg.assigned(*lit), Some(false)) inside the subsumption/elimination check).
comment: The assertion fires during preprocessing in well under a second; a short timeout keeps non-crashing candidates (which splr would otherwise try to fully solve) from dominating the reduction.
